video_generation_prompt: Ultra-premium CGI commercial for Nestlé NAN COMFOR Família Comfor. Locked frontal camera, 70mm equivalent, 5-second static shot. Seamless first-to-last frame interpolation starting exactly as FRAME-1 and ending exactly as FRAME-2. STRICT BRAND PRESERVATION: preserve exact NAN COMFOR package geometry, proportions, scale, label placement, typography, magenta-to-purple gradient background, and the exact reference bird from packaging artwork: flat white silhouette body, deep magenta-burgundy outline contour lines, long pointed sharp beak, stylized curved head crest, rounded compact chest, broad angular wings with deep magenta edging, elegant tail at every frame. TIMELINE: 0.00-0.55s: magenta background begins nearly empty as delicate molecular networks, luminous particles and circular technological arcs emerge from both sides with restrained precision. 0.55-1.20s: smooth vortex of natural white milk rises from the base forming elegant spirals with suspended symbols of vitamins, probiotics and nucleotides glowing softly inside the liquid. 1.20-1.75s: first NAN COMFOR can rises from within the milk vortex and settles in rear-left position, label fully legible. 1.75-2.30s: second NAN COMFOR can emerges from the same base flow and moves into rear-right position, label fully legible. 2.30-2.90s: central NAN COMFOR can rises last, larger and closer, locking into front-center composition with luminous pulse on landing. 2.90-3.60s: exact reference bird — flat white body, deep magenta outlines, long pointed beak, curved crest, rounded chest and broad angular wings — flies upward from behind the camera, one wing passing extremely close to the lens as a dramatic foreground wipe, then lands inside the front-central can artwork. 3.60-4.20s: milk vortex softens into refined circular base while molecular elements continue orbiting subtly; side cans shift slightly outward. 4.20-5.00s: concentrated particles and light form the final seal resolving exactly into FRAME-2 with premium sense of science, technology and innovation. No subtitles. No text overlay.
negative_prompt: deformed packaging, incorrect proportions, label distortion, illegible text, brand replacement, logo alteration, unauthorized color shift, additional products, extra objects, people, hands, utensils, subtitles, watermarks, camera cuts within clip, background replacement, physics glitches, identity drift, hallucinated graphics, hallucinated text, motion blur obscuring labels, excessive bloom, lens dirt, chromatic aberration, incorrect bird design, bird color changes, package intersection, floating packages after settling, particle explosion
camera: Locked frontal, 70mm full-frame equivalent. Zero camera movement. Bird wing creates foreground wipe at 2.90-3.00s.
lighting: Large diffused frontal key light. Low-intensity magenta ambient fill. Subtle magenta-violet rim on can edges. Milk is naturally lit — high translucency with soft backlight. Particles are self-luminous.
motion: molecular drift (background), milk vortex rise (0.55s), sequential can rises, bird wing wipe + landing, vortex soften, seal resolve
